error_time: Write the time as HH:MM, like 09:00
error_interval: The interval must be between 5 minutes and 7 days
error_past: That time has passed. Pick a later one
error_until: That end time has passed. Pick a later one, or clear it.
template_meeting_prompt: Check today's meetings in my Lark calendar and iPhone calendar. For each one that needs prep, use schedule_followup to set up a prep 10 minutes before it: related docs, notes from the last meeting, open questions, and the points I should make. If nothing needs prep today, just say so briefly.
template_weekly_prompt: Draft my weekly report: from my Lark calendar, meeting notes, docs, and messages, pull together what I did this week, progress and results, problems I ran into, and next week's plan. Include the main changes the agents on my computers finished this week. Give me a draft first and ask if I want changes. Don't send it.
template_patrol_prompt: Check the agents on my computers: which are waiting for me, which are stuck or hit errors, and which finished with nobody looking. List anything I need to handle (one per line, saying which computer and what it's waiting for). If all is well, just reply "All good".
template_wrapup_prompt: End-of-day review: messages I haven't replied to today, things I promised people but haven't done, agents on my computers still running or waiting for me, and meetings tomorrow morning that need prep. List them by urgency, then ask which ones I want reminders for.
